cells.quote: poses a number of difficulties for social constructivist analyses of the history of science, difficulties that do not confront realist interpretations.
cells.note: The study text reports a philosophical argument attributed to Kragh, not an empirical learning comparison. The preface also states that Kragh maintains rejection of social constructivism does not entail rejection of social or historical studies of science and urges their inclusion in the science curriculum.
